description: Pages with zero recorded clicks in the last 90 days, each with a verdict (KEEP, OPTIMIZE, MERGE, REDIRECT or REVIEW FOR REMOVAL) and the evidence. A trigger for review, never for automatic deletion; pages Search Console returned nothing for are reported as unknown, not as zero. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
